skill: Apply stated elementary row operations to an augmented matrix and select the resulting matrix from five choices.
learner_operation: Read operation type, target and source row indices and scalar; swap whole rows or update every entry (including the constants column); for two operations use the updated intermediate matrix, then distinguish the matching option.
reasoning_steps: Apply the operation entrywise including the augmented column
Carry updated rows into a second operation when specified
Compare the whole result with the five-option bank
response_contract: Single radio selection among five math matrices. Canonical example has no captured answer field. Source q-10252 lacks correct-answer link and solution; its fifth choice is independently inferable as correct.

Arithmetic and matrix comparison are the necessary reasoning
Easy work remains one swap or scaling
incidental_assignments: Which rows are swapped, scaled, or combined
Scalar sign and magnitude within comparable arithmetic
Input entries and location of zero/cancellation
Which source row feeds the second operation
permitted_variations: Small signed integer entries, occasional zeros, and exact reciprocal scalars
Two or three rows and three or four total columns grounded in source shapes
Any eligible row index or swap pair rather than fixed source row roles
Vary coefficients without requiring cancellation in a predetermined column
Permute option positions and maintain plausible distinct whole-matrix distractors
Matrix renaming is irrelevant and must preserve the mathematical result
